numeric_candidate_regression.mechanism: query has no numeric tokens; removing numeric terms from all expansion documents changes BM25 length normalization enough to move Svetsteknik teacher rank 4 to 5. The fixed three-teacher-slot fusion boundary then excludes it from top5. This is a real global side effect, not the original numbered-section artifact.

decisions.teacher_lane: retain G1+teacher representation and frozen G1+T3 fusion as the low-complexity descriptive-retrieval candidate; the final 16 teacher entries created no observed regression on canonical, AF, or prior synthetic guards
decisions.drop_numeric_documents_and_queries: reject for promotion: it improves one source-attested boundary case but causes a new prefrozen fresh regression through global BM25 document-length normalization
decisions.next_smallest_hypothesis: development-test query-only pure-integer removal in G1/teacher ranking while leaving C0, exact surfaces, and all indexed documents unchanged; any promotion requires new independent prefrozen evidence because ranks301-316 are now opened

interpretation_boundary: The 16-case final slice is temporally prefrozen and target-disjoint but model-authored. It is strong falsification evidence for global side effects and cross-target competition, not independent human/user accuracy evidence.
